items.heading: Nyama Choma
details: Key ingredients: goat or beef, salt, kachumbari
Season large cuts of goat or beef simply with salt.
Grill slowly over charcoal, turning occasionally, until deeply charred.
Rest briefly, then chop into pieces.
Serve with a fresh tomato and onion kachumbari salad.

items.heading: Ugali with Sukuma Wiki
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, water, collard greens, onion, tomato
Whisk corn flour into boiling water, stirring until it thickens into a stiff dough.
Continue stirring and kneading in the pot until smooth (ugali).
Saute shredded collard greens with onion and tomato.
Serve the ugali alongside the sauteed greens.
